note: Measured in the ngspice sky130 tt corner. sky130 offers nfet svt/lvt (no hvt) and pfet svt/hvt (no lvt), so the fabricable Vt span is nfet_svt+pfet_hvt (highest Vt) to nfet_lvt+pfet_svt (lowest Vt). Intermediate dopant is a hypothesis, not a foundry mask.

fit.why: The pfet-only point saw a 6465x leakage cliff and a 23pct speed knob. Adding the measured nfet low-Vt point shows the true full-inverter span is 71x leak and 18.9pct speed, and that speed and leakage are asymmetric across the two transistors: nfet lvt is nearly free, pfet svt is the expensive knob.
